text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, what is it~?
Not gonna comfort me with a "Too bad, huh"?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Nn-nn. I think I'll pass this time.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Because Curren is definitely taking 1st place next time!
I'll be much happier getting praised then!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll totally steal everyone's attention with a sparkly *pew*! Teehee☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren is going to get even cuter,
so get ready to swoon even more, Big Brother, okay?
choice_data_list: I wonder if I can do it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
As Curren gets cuter and cuter,
make sure your heart races even mooore for me, Big Sis, okay?
choice_data_list: I wonder if I can do it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yep! And if you spoil Curren even moooore,
I'll give you a flower stamp of approval!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And with that, I reviewed this race alongside Curren Chan,
who pushes herself harder than anyone else to reach the top."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, that's so mean, so mean!
There is nothing Curren can't do!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You know very well yourself, Big Brother.
You tease!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You already know, Big Sis.
Oh, you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just like that,
Curren Chan's fighting spirit was rekindled for what lay ahead.
